title: fix(i18n): zh sign-out menu item reads 退出登录, not 注销
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi95wmrfZ1NLxKfZkRLtH7cbp)_

Fixes #25871

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

The Chinese (`zh`) pack's `user.logout`, the sign-out item in the console's user menu, read 「注销」. A Chinese reader takes that as "cancel / delete my account". It now reads 「退出登录」, the wording the same pack already uses for signing out (the admin-session `notRestored` message and the `signOut` row).

- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/zh.ts`: `user.logout` 注销 → 退出登录. No key added or removed; other locales unchanged.
- `.changeset/25871-zh-logout-label.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` patch, in the root `.changeset/`.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`: registry-source hash re-recorded with `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` (any `ui/packages/**` source edit moves it). `sdui.manifest.json` itself is byte-identical.

## Premise check

At `origin/main` 39a78b15, `git grep -n 注销 -- ui apps packages` has exactly one hit, this row, so no other surface uses 注销 to mean sign-out.

## Verification (head ca2aff66)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n test --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 87 passed (87), Tests 1353 passed, 13 skipped.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 41 derived commands, each exit 0; `--ran` reconciles "41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)".
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: intact, generated from the in-tree registry as it stands.
- Type-check of `@object-ui/i18n` not run locally (a one-string value change); left to CI `Type Check UI`.

## Acceptance notes

None.
